prose: Keith Parker is the founder of Field Dynamics, a nexus for energetic healing and education. In the course of Keith's unique life path, he used consciousness sharpening techniques consistently enough to develop an innate ability to see and interact with Chakras as an objective reality. His personal experience and deep thirst for scientific exploration has led Keith to a much deeper understanding of the eternal source singularity, the blending of spirit and science, and the fractally nested fields of memory that we call life, the universe, and everything.
ext: Topics include the dendritic pattern, the mind & aura as analogue to time, and transcendental idealism, the ring past not, the flaw in so-called artificial intelligence, holographic ancestors and spirit attachments, experiencing the plasmatic astral plane, and much more.
